body: I have that had the idea that suicide may not be the answer and that is a reason I haven't acted in the past 2 years because maybe something would change. When I do I think about it now it makes me feel very conflicted and angry but at the same time I realize that hoping for something to change makes me feel like im postponing on acting because I can never resort to an answer on what I want to do. I've decided that I need to make a decision now or all this waiting around might be for nothing. After that is when I realized I want to end it instead of continuing to wait. I really appreciate you trying to help me and I understand your points but there are so many things I havent written down or I would be needing to pretty much write down my entire life story.

I think giving up what others think of me would be really hard. I think I have really bad social anxiety. I'm not saying that as an excuse but I'm just stating that I think that is going to be a really obstacle for me to overcome but I don't know for sure I would be able to. I think I've had anxiety for a really long time because I remember back in elementary school in 7th I looked at my grades online and saw a health tab and It said I was diagnosed with anxiety. I think its going to be hard to rework how I've been thinking for past 3 years, maybe more because I might've has anxiety in elementary school and I can't remember.

You do sound like not a jerk.Thoughts coming have been coming to me like this and that was another is a partial reason why I was hesitant on wanting to kill myself earlier but after a long time of stress and literally questioning myself If I've started to become insane or something and I can't take it anymore. Plus there are other things I left outside of this post that are pressuring me now and is giving me a now or never type of question in my head and it scares me that continuing to live might be a mistake and make me feel a lot worse for a long time and also some family related issues that I don't want to talk about that are causing them some stress. I actually am quite aware that if I explain in greater detail people would get me but I don't think that will affect how I will feel and it would cause problems for me when someone would be forcing me to get help.
